name: Unicorn
h1: Unicorn birthday parties, styled with sparkle & taste.
metaDescription: Planning a unicorn birthday party in Singapore? OurKampung styles dreamy, pastel unicorn parties — décor, cake, entertainment and venue, coordinated end to end.
intro: A unicorn party doesn't have to mean plastic rainbows and clashing colour. We reimagine it in soft pastels, gilded horns and cloud-like balloon installations — magical for your little one, genuinely beautiful for the grown-ups. From backdrop to cake to party favours, our Singapore concierge coordinates every detail so the day feels effortless.
ideas: Pastel balloon garland with a matte gold unicorn horn centrepiece
A tiered cake with hand-piped mane detail and edible gold leaf
Iridescent tableware, star confetti and cloud-shaped place cards
Make-your-own unicorn headband craft corner for the little guests

faqs.q: How much does a unicorn birthday party cost in Singapore?
faqs.a: It depends on guest numbers, venue and how elaborate the décor is. Most of our styled unicorn parties start from a few hundred dollars for décor-only setups and scale up with cake, entertainment and catering. Tell us your budget and we'll tailor a package that fits.

faqs.q: Can you do a unicorn party at my condo function room or at home?
faqs.a: Yes. We regularly style condo function rooms, HDB spaces and homes across Singapore. We handle delivery, setup and teardown so you don't lift a finger.

faqs.q: How far in advance should I book?
faqs.a: We recommend two to four weeks for a fully styled party, though we can often accommodate shorter timelines. Message us as early as you can to secure your preferred date.

name: Superhero
metaDescription: Planning a superhero birthday party in Singapore? OurKampung styles action-packed hero celebrations — bold décor, capes, games, cake and full coordination.
intro: Cue the theme music — a superhero party is all action, styled with a confident, graphic palette that still looks put-together. We balance the bold colours with clean detailing, add a cape-and-mask moment for every guest, and build in games that let the little heroes save the day. Our Singapore concierge runs it end to end.
ideas: A bold comic-style balloon backdrop with a skyline silhouette
A 'hero academy' obstacle course and training-badge ceremony
A cape-and-mask station so every guest gets their superpowers
A comic-panel cake with a dramatic drip finish

faqs.q: Can you bring a superhero character or host?
faqs.a: Yes — we can arrange a costumed hero to lead the training games, do a meet-and-greet and pose for photos. Let us know which hero is the favourite.

faqs.q: What activities work well for a superhero party?
faqs.a: Obstacle courses, 'training' challenges, a badge ceremony and team missions all go down brilliantly. We tailor the difficulty to the age group.

faqs.q: Do you have a space requirement for the games?
faqs.a: A little open floor helps for the active games, but we've run great superhero parties in function rooms and homes. We'll plan the layout around your venue.

name: Paw Patrol
h1: Rescue-pup parties, adventurous and full of heart.
metaDescription: Planning a Paw Patrol birthday party in Singapore? OurKampung styles fun rescue-pup adventures inspired by the show — décor, mission games, cake and full coordination.
intro: For the little one who's ready for action, we style rescue-pup parties full of adventure — bright primary tones, playful paw-print details and a 'rescue mission' spirit. It's energetic and instantly recognisable for the kids, and we keep the setup crisp and photogenic. From the mission games to the cake, we run the whole rescue for you.
ideas: A bright balloon backdrop with playful paw-print accents
A 'rescue mission' obstacle course and badge ceremony
Pup-ear headbands or badges for every little recruit

faqs.q: What age is a Paw Patrol party best for?
faqs.a: It's most loved by toddlers and young children, roughly ages two to six. We scale the mission games to suit the group.

faqs.q: Do you use official Paw Patrol characters?
faqs.a: We style parties inspired by the show's colours and rescue-mission theme rather than licensed artwork, so the look stays tasteful and bespoke.

faqs.q: Can you add entertainment or a host?
faqs.a: Yes — we can bring a host to run the rescue missions and games, keeping the little recruits happily occupied.
